last.verdict: Profit beat, but a slower Q4 outlook and lower ad forecast hurt the stock.

reasons.label: Ad forecast cut
reasons.text: 2026 ad revenue now expected near $2.7B, down from about $3B, on slower ad-product rollout.

reasons.label: Slowing growth
reasons.text: Revenue growth slowed to 12% in Q3, with Q4 guided to about 12% too.

reasons.label: Timing flattered profit
reasons.text: Margin of 34.6% beat forecast mainly from expense timing; Q4 margin guided down to 26%.

story: Netflix has dropped after each of the last three reports despite solid results. April fell about 9% on soft guidance, July about 7% as growth outlook slowed. Revenue growth has faded from 16% to 12% while buybacks hit records.
